# Santella Designs

> One-person jewelry studio of silversmith and goldsmith Noah Santella, based in New Hampshire, USA. Original sterling silver and gold jewelry made one piece at a time (each design is made once and never repeated), plus professional repair and restoration.

## The maker

Noah Santella trained at university and as a professional bench jeweler. He builds most pieces from bars of raw .999 silver, carrying them through alloying, forging, stone setting, and finishing himself. He favors stones with depth and movement: labradorite, lapis, azurite, jasper, moissanite, and diamond.

## Services

- Original commissioned jewelry in sterling silver and gold (one-off designs, never repeated)
- Stone setting and replacement (bezels, prongs, frames)
- Ring resizing and chain repair
- Professional polishing and refinishing
- Gemstone recutting on professional lapidary equipment
- Watch repair and movement servicing

## Signature pieces (current collection)

- Nightfall: azurite cabochon in a twisted sterling rope bezel with chased silver feathers
- Moon's Tear: 32.5 ct labradorite teardrop in an engraved Baroque sterling bezel
- Prairie Fire: Montana polychrome jasper with sulphur patina and rainbow-oxidized feathers
- Smoked Whiskey: red jasper in an engraved sterling cuff with freehand scrollwork
